operator_setup: User held the cube by its other faces and reports preventing cube movement throughout the pull.
useful_for: Effective resistance during combined TPU bending and observed sliding against a cube reported stationary under hand restraint.
interpretation: The operator reports a stationary cube and TPU pad bending plus sliding. After initial preload unloading, the opposing axial load averaged 8.40 N over 1.5-4.8 mm of robot travel and peaked at 8.96 N. Use this as provisional effective sliding resistance for the complete gripper at raw speed 0 / force 0, not a static holding maximum or opposing finger squeeze force.
limitation: Sliding onset was not timestamped. Bending and sliding contributions, normal squeeze force, and friction coefficient cannot be separated from this run. Hand restraint and cube motion were not instrumented. No finger-position trajectory was recorded during the arm pull. The force-drop detector did not flag sustained sliding, which need not produce a force drop.
operator_observation_of_pad_relative_sli: TPU pads bent and slid along the cube during the pull.
